patterns: Some checks would have said 'yes' no matter what. Now every test must be able to come out negative.
June's bot vs autumn's bot looked like one result. Now everything is split by month first.
Missing log files were weekly rotation, not a dead bot. Now only never-deleted records count.
Not saying how much a test could see
'Nothing found' by tests that could only see huge effects. Now every result states what it could have detected.
Cutoffs on values with a default
Most coins sit at Hyperliquid's default funding rate, so 'top 20%' flagged 85% of coins. Now cutoffs use 'strictly above', and live flags are tested from their actual code, not their description.
